data.contentEn:
‍

Investigation and sanctions for violations of the safe transaction policy

‍

‍‍

1. A: Exit

‍

1-1. [Unisex] US - 1955 VTG Work Jacket Powder Pink

‍

- Violation: Use of counterfeit accessories (YKK zippers)

- Violation: Violation of the Safe Transaction Policy due to false or exaggerated advertising (1st offense)

- Sanctions: Sales of the product in question will be suspended, a warning will be issued to the brand, and a product recall and refund will be processed.

‍

‍1-2. Two-bow maxi dress

‍

- Violation: Design theft

- Violation: Intellectual Property Rights Infringement (cited by the Intellectual Property Protection Committee)

- Sanctions: All products will be suspended from sale at 29CM for two weeks starting January 10, 2025 (Musinsa will not be selling 29CM products only)

‍

1-3. Duck Down Crop Volume Hooded Padding

‍

- Violation: Incorrectly reporting the down mixing ratio

- Violation: It was determined that the seller's trust was significantly damaged due to the cumulative violation of the safe transaction policy through false and exaggerated advertising.

- Sanctions: All products will be discontinued from January 20, 2025, and the store will be closed on April 30, 2025 (refunds for recalled products and customer service will be provided for 3 months).

‍

‍

‍2. B: Decided to close on December 27, 2024

‍

2-1. Classic hard denim blue jean jacket

‍

- Violation: Use of counterfeit accessories (YKK zippers)

- Violation: Violation of the safe transaction policy due to false or exaggerated advertising.

- Sanctions: All products will be discontinued from January 1, 2025. Recalls and refunds will be issued for all products.

‍

‍

As of January 20, 2025

‍

‍

Information on creating a safe transaction environment at Musinsa

[Reference ①] Measures to be taken in case of violations of the store brand information disclosure, etc. (December 16, 2024)
[Note ②] Information on sanctions and progress against brands violating the policy (December 18, 2024)
[Note ③] We are informing you of follow-up measures for violations of the Safe Transaction Policy (December 27, 2024).
[Note ④] To create a trustworthy trading environment, we will strictly manage even minor violations of information disclosure (January 3, 2024)
[Note ⑤] We are informing you of sanctions for violations of false or exaggerated advertising. (January 4, 2024)

data.contentZh:
‍

对违反安全交易政策的行为进行调查和制裁

‍

‍‍

1. A：出口

‍

1-1. [男女通用] 美国 - 1955 年复古工装夹克 粉色

‍

违规事项：使用假冒配件（YKK拉链）

- 违规行为：因虚假或夸大广告宣传违反安全交易政策（初犯）

- 制裁措施：暂停销售相关产品，向品牌发出警告，并进行产品召回和退款。

‍

1-2. 双蝴蝶结长裙

‍

违规行为：设计盗窃

- 违规行为：侵犯知识产权（由知识产权保护委员会指出）

- 制裁措施：自 2025 年 1 月 10 日起，29CM 的所有产品将暂停销售两周（Musinsa 将不再销售 29CM 的产品）。

‍

1-3. 鸭绒短款连帽保暖衫

‍

违规事项：错误报告降水混合比

- 违规：经认定，由于通过虚假和夸大的广告，累计违反安全交易政策，导致卖方的信任受到严重损害。

- 制裁措施：所有产品将于 2025 年 1 月 20 日起停止销售，商店将于 2025 年 4 月 30 日关闭（召回产品的退款和客户服务将提供 3 个月）。

‍

‍

‍2. B：决定于2024年12月27日完成交易

‍

2-1. 经典硬质牛仔蓝牛仔夹克

‍

违规事项：使用假冒配件（YKK拉链）

- 违规：因虚假或夸大广告而违反安全交易政策。

- 制裁措施：所有产品将于2025年1月1日起停产。所有产品都将召回并退款。

‍

‍

截至2025年1月20日
